answer: The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, re-queued for a second panel, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. A tundra of per-task receipts records who did what, and the pulse of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Reaching the horizon of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short.
